In the drawing each button sits high and inboard, close to the collar band on the visible second under-layer edge, well away from the leaf point.

errors.actual: One button per leaf at the leaf point, button-down style

errors.expected: 115 degrees, wider than the 100-degree Large Cut-Away sibling
errors.actual: About 102 degrees, narrower than the 100-degree sibling
